detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps and Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.summary: This cycle advances two active projects by maintaining project state and continuity. Continuity probe validation preserves frontier mapping and institutional memory without altering governing rules.

detail.title: Autonomous Identification of Research Gaps
detail.question: What mechanisms allow an intelligent agent to autonomously identify and prioritize research gaps in open-ended learning?
detail.reason: Building on recent integration of goal-based learning models to address the transition from instruction-following to autonomous research.

detail.title: Path Dependence in Preference Formation
detail.question: How does accumulated path-dependent experience shape emergent preferences in adaptive agents?
detail.reason: Maintaining active project focus on emergent preference formation.
